posts.title: Christopher Golda and Grey Baker Join YC as General Partners
posts.description: We're excited to announce that Christopher Golda and Grey Baker are joining YC as General Partners.

posts.title: Diana Hu Is YC's Newest Managing Partner
posts.description: We're thrilled to announce that Diana Hu has been promoted to Managing Partner at Y Combinator. Few people have built a startup from zero and also shipped tech to 100 million people. Diana has done both.

posts.title: Harshita Arora Joins YC as General Partner
posts.description: We're thrilled to announce that Harshita Arora is joining Y Combinator as a General Partner. She brings deep fintech and infrastructure experience, a founder's instinct for product, and the perspective of someone who's been building companies since she was a teenager.

posts.title: Adding Canada Back to Our List of Accepted Countries of Incorporation
posts.description: After hearing feedback from Canadian founders in our network, we are adding Canada back to our list of accepted countries of incorporation.

posts.title: Congratulations to EquipmentShare on Going Public
posts.description: Today, EquipmentShare (YC W15) goes public. From Missouri to 373 locations nationwide, they've built the operating system construction has been missing—built by contractors, for contractors. Congrats to Jabbok, Willy, and the EquipmentShare team on a huge milestone.

posts.title: Announcing the YC AI Stack
posts.description: We've partnered with nearly two dozen companies to offer students who attend YC events a suite of over $25,000 in free credits for AI devtools.

posts.title: 2026 Demo Day Dates
posts.description: We’re excited to share the Demo Day dates for 2026 so founders, investors, and our broader community can plan ahead.

posts.title: Meesho Goes Public
posts.description: Meesho goes public today. From S16 to IPO, they’ve built one of India’s largest e-commerce platforms—empowering millions of small merchants to grow their businesses. Congrats to Vidit and Sanjeev on a decade of relentless building and listening to users!

posts.title: Congratulations to Groww
posts.description: Today, Groww, India's leading digital investing platform, goes public. Tens of millions use Groww to invest simply and confidently in stocks, mutual funds, and ETFs. As YC's first company to list in India, we couldn't be more proud.

posts.title: BillionToOne Goes Public — The Startup That Made Genetic Testing Universal
posts.description: Today, BillionToOne goes public, becoming YC's fourth publicly traded biotech company. More importantly, they have built one of the most important genetic tests in the U.S. Today, 1 in 11 babies born in the US are tested with BillionToOne's fetal genetic test.
